prerequisites: Knowledge of symbols, graphics, specific to electrical diagrams

learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition of basic, theoretical and practical knowledge regarding the design and operation of electro-pneumatic and electro-hydraulic systems.
Defining the basic concepts regarding the operation and maintenance of electro-hydro-pneumatic systems.
Present the theoretical elements related to the design and operation of electro-pneumatic and electro-hydraulic systems.
Familiarize students with practical aspects regarding the operation of electro-pneumatic systems.

syllabus_topics: Training on work safety norms specific to the laboratory. Presentation of laboratory works from the discipline Electro-pneumatic and electro-hydraulic systems.
Study of the operation of the MR pneumatic manipulator within the PN2800 station used in the laboratory;
Study of the operation of the MP pneumatic manipulator within the PN2800 station used in the laboratory;
Study of the operation of the MR pneumatic manipulator within the PN2000 station used in the laboratory;
Study of the semi-automatic operation of the ST2000 station used in the laboratory;
Throttle adjustment of the speed for a linear pneumatic motor;
Closing the situation at the laboratory. Presentation of the laboratory reports.
teaching_methods: Face-to-face course presentation in amphitheater with video projector, screen, blackboard, oral speech
assessment_rules: The final mark is composed of 50% from the course evaluation and 50% from the laboratory grade. The course evaluation involves periodic checks in week 7 and week 14. For the laboratory, all work must be performed, and the laboratory grade equals 50% of the VP value for each stage. A maximum of two laboratory works can be recovered (30% of the total). Participation at laboratory hours below 70% leads to the restoration of the discipline.
